def factor_momentum_vol_regime_amp(df):
    df_copy = df.copy()
    mom = df_copy["close"].pct_change(5)
    is_high_vol, is_low_vol, vol_ratio = alpha_tools.classify_volume_regime(df_copy["volume"], window=10)
    signal = mom * vol_ratio
    power = 1.5
    signed_power = np.sign(signal) * np.abs(signal) ** power
    df_copy["factor_momentum_vol_regime_amp"] = signed_power
    return df_copy["factor_momentum_vol_regime_amp"]
